THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

2 Protein Dessert Backups When the Creami Isn't Ready

Ninja Creami is my favorite — but it takes planning. When the pint isn't frozen, these are the 2 protein desserts I grab. Choose ONE (do not add together).

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME2 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~300 cal | ~27g protein

Ingredients

OPTION 1: PROTEIN PINTS COFFEE (180 CAL / 15G PROTEIN)

  • 1.5 labeled servings Protein Pints Coffee (any Protein Pints flavor works — Coffee is my favorite)

OPTION 2: PRIME BITES BROWNIE BOWL (~300 CAL / 25-30G PROTEIN)

  • 1 Prime Bites Protein Brownie, any flavor (~220 cal / 19g protein per brownie)
  • 1/4 pint lighter or high-protein ice cream — Halo Top, Frozen One, or Protein Pints all work

The Ninja Creami takes planning — you have to freeze the pint hours ahead. These are the 2 protein desserts I grab when I forget. Option 1 wins when you want ice cream by itself. Option 2 wins when you want a brownie-forward dessert. Sibling recipe to the [Chocolate Protein Brownie Bowl](/cookbook/chocolate-protein-brownie-bowl) — same Prime Bites brownie base, cold-ice-cream pairing instead of the Bootylicious muffin cup. Adult-only macro dessert; not designed for kids.

Method

  1. 1.OPTION 1 — PROTEIN PINTS COFFEE (180 CAL / 15G PROTEIN): Measure 1.5 labeled servings from a Protein Pints pint (Coffee is my favorite — the best protein ice cream I've tried). Any flavor works. Serve immediately. This is the pick when you want ice cream on its own with zero assembly.
  2. 2.OPTION 2 — PRIME BITES BROWNIE BOWL (~300 CAL / 25-30G PROTEIN): Unwrap 1 Prime Bites protein brownie and place it in a small dessert bowl. Any flavor works.
  3. 3.SCOOP 1/4 PINT ICE CREAM ON TOP. Add 1/4 pint of lighter or high-protein ice cream — Halo Top and Frozen One are both examples. Halo Top and Frozen One are average on their own; paired with the brownie, the full dessert becomes an easy 8/10.
  4. 4.EAT IMMEDIATELY. The ice cream starts softening into the brownie within 30-60 seconds. The pairing IS the fix — two average products become one real dessert.

If something fails

Not sure which option to pick: If you want plain ice cream and nothing else, go Option 1 (Protein Pints Coffee — the best-tasting protein ice cream I've tried). If you want a brownie-forward dessert with the ice cream as the crown, go Option 2. They serve different cravings; do not combine.

Option 2 macros came in higher than 300: Most likely cause: (1) over-scooped the ice cream (1/4 pint = one heaped scoop, not half the pint), (2) used a higher-cal Prime Bites flavor (Chocolate Glazed Donut is ~220 cal, some flavors run 180-220), or (3) picked a higher-cal ice cream (regular Halo Top ≠ Halo Top Protein). Stick to 1 brownie + 1/4 pint of a labeled lighter or high-protein pint.

Ice cream rock-hard out of the freezer: Let the pint sit at room temp 2-3 min before scooping. Protein Pints, Frozen One, and Halo Top all freeze harder than premium dairy ice cream (no air whipped in). Or run the scoop under warm water.

The pairing doesn't taste like more than the sum of parts: Match the ice cream flavor to the brownie flavor. Chocolate brownie + Coffee ice cream works. Birthday Cake brownie + Vanilla ice cream works. Mismatched flavors (S'mores brownie + Mint Chocolate) fight each other — the whole 8/10 comes from complementary flavors, not just cold-on-warm.

Prime Bites brownie feels dry: Some flavor lots run drier than others. Optional rescue: 15-20 sec in the microwave before topping with ice cream — softens the interior. Not required for the recipe, just a save if the brownie feels stale.

Storage and reheating

Store: N/A — make per serving. Both brownies and ice-cream pints are shelf/freezer stable individually per their labels.

Reheat: N/A — assemble fresh. Option 2's cold-on-brownie contrast is the dessert; reheating a leftover bowl wrecks it.

Lasts: Prime Bites brownies: months at room temp (per package date). Protein Pints / Frozen One / Halo Top pints: months in the freezer (per package date). The assembled Option 2 bowl doesn't store — eat immediately.

Brands I use

Protein Pints
Coffee (Option 1 — 180 cal / 15g protein for 1.5 servings from a pint. Any Protein Pints flavor works)
Coffee is my favorite Protein Pints flavor and the best protein ice cream I've tried. Real ice cream texture, coffee-forward, no chalk. This is what I grab when I want dessert to be one thing and one thing only. Not sponsored, not affiliated. Any flavor works — Coffee is just the pick.
Prime Bites
Protein Brownie (Option 2 base — 19g protein, 5g collagen, low sugar, ~180-220 cal per brownie depending on flavor)
The individually-wrapped protein brownie that anchors Option 2. Any flavor works. Cross-recipe with the [Chocolate Protein Brownie Bowl](/cookbook/chocolate-protein-brownie-bowl) elsewhere in the cookbook. Not sponsored, not affiliated.
Halo Top / Frozen One / Protein Pints
1/4 pint lighter or high-protein ice cream (Option 2 topping)
Halo Top and Frozen One are average on their own — that's the honest read. Paired with a Prime Bites brownie, the full dessert becomes an easy 8/10. The brownie is doing the heavy lifting; the ice cream is the temperature/texture partner. Any lighter or high-protein pint works.
